name: Core boundaries and source checks

on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: core-boundaries-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  core-boundaries:
    runs-on: windows-2022
    timeout-minutes: 20
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: pwsh
        working-directory: Loom
    steps:
      - name: Check out Loom
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: Loom
          persist-credentials: false

      # Match the installed board package. The existing host runner expects this sibling path.
      - name: Check out ArduinoJson 6.20.1 headers
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: bblanchon/ArduinoJson
          ref: v6.20.1
          path: ArduinoJson
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Check warning scopes, examples and debug boundaries
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $checks = 'verify_warning_scope.ps1', 'verify_example_includes.ps1',
                    'verify_wisp_example_mirrors.ps1', 'verify_wisp_diagnostic_boundaries.ps1'
          foreach ($check in $checks) {
            & pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File (Join-Path tests $check)
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Source check failed: $check" }
          }

      - name: Run core boundary programs
        run: ./tests/verify_core_boundaries.ps1

      - name: Run SD data safety program
        run: ./tests/verify_data_safety.ps1

      - name: Run offline receipt and viewer checks
        run: |
          python -B -m unittest discover -s tools/service_mock -p 'test_*.py' -v
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Receipt checks failed.' }
          node tools/service_mock/test_viewer.js
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Viewer checks failed.' }

      # No board SDK, network credentials, firmware upload or automatic Git writes are needed.
      # Physical faults and real broker/database delivery still require separate acceptance.
